description: Unit tests for net/http/http_network_layer, testing HTTP transactions, proxy fallback, and network verification in Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: HttpNetworkLayerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing HttpNetworkLayer, including setup of mock network environment and various test cases.

methods.name: CreateAndDestroy
methods.description: Test creating and destroying an HttpTransaction.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Test suspending and resuming the HttpNetworkLayer.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Test performing a simple GET request and verifying response content.

methods.name: NetworkVerified
methods.description: Test that a successful request marks the network as accessed.

methods.name: NetworkUnVerified
methods.description: Test that a failed request still marks the network as accessed.
